runs.prompt: Lets run 3: there's a bulk order for 20 size M hoodies. We want to make the higher of a 30% margin or a public comp from a competitor. Which discount are we showing the competitor?

comparables.name: University of Windsor Bookstore (departmental orders)
comparables.note: Larger special bulk orders get 25%, but the threshold isn't published, so it isn't used.

comparables.name: Agon Swim (custom wholesale orders)
comparables.note: 12+ units earn 15/25/30% depending on the retailer's annual volume; the entry-level 15% is used since this is a one-off order.

not_bulk_context.name: Stanford Student Store
not_bulk_context.note: Everyday student discount, not a bulk discount.

not_bulk_context.name: Rice University bookstore spirit items
not_bulk_context.note: Monthly 10% off designated spirit items; not a bulk discount.

not_bulk_context.name: Missouri State University bookstore
not_bulk_context.note: Student discount on clothing and logoed items; not a bulk discount.

recommended.reason: Matches the competitor benchmark, which stays above the margin threshold.
